name: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions

meta.wiki: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions

summary: Primal Torntusk has sent you to Jintha'alor to bring Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions to justice. He offers a grand prize for slaying Hexx and her elite Aman'zasi guard.

sections.title: A Strike at Jintha'alor
sections.body: Primal Torntusk sends you after Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions. They are atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands, where Hexx's elite Aman'zasi guards stand with her. Slay them, then report to Torntusk at Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Who posted the bounty for Vile Priestess Hexx?
faq.answer: Primal Torntusk ordered the bounty and offers a grand prize for slaying the priestess and her guard.

faq.q: Where can Vile Priestess Hexx and her guards be found?
faq.answer: Vile Priestess Hexx and her guards are atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Who must be slain to fulfill the bounty?
faq.answer: Slay Priestess Hexx and her elite Aman'zasi guard of the Vilebranch.

faq.q: Where is the bounty turned in?
aliases: where to turn in hexx bounty
faq.answer: After slaying the priestess and her guard, report to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village.
